title: Equipment over 5,000 EUR is capex
question: You moved that one to capex. What made you do that?
warning: Equipment over €5,000 is capex, cost center 0400, not opex 4711. Change the cost center before you post.

title: Hold the supplier that double-bills in December
question: You are holding this one. What do you know about this supplier that the screen does not show?
warning: This supplier double-bills every December. Hold the invoice and check for a duplicate before you post.

title: Czech subsidiary invoices need a second approval
question: You sent this one for approval instead of posting it. Why does this invoice need a second pair of eyes?
warning: Invoices from the Czech subsidiary need a second approval. Use Send for approval, do not post it alone.
why: It comes from the Czech subsidiary, so it goes for a second approval.

title: Equipment coded to opex
question: This is equipment on cost center 4711. What decides opex versus capex for you?
warning: Equipment over €5,000 is always capex. If this is over the line, re-code from opex 4711 to capex 0400 before posting.

title: No asset number, no capex booking
question: You booked this to capex. What has to be in place before a capex booking goes through?
warning: No asset number, no capex booking. Fill in the asset number before you post to 0400.
why: No asset number, no capex booking.

title: Unknown supplier: stop and ask the controller
question: This supplier is not in the vendor master. What do you do when you meet one?
warning: Unknown supplier. Stop, do not post, and ask the controller.
why: Unknown supplier: stop and ask the controller.
